name: fillet-over-a-hole-centre
why: The hole-rim part with the fillet at 5 mm, its foot past the hole's centre. OpenCASCADE's own cut-then-fillet rolls the ball along the rim between the crossings and reports a twisted surface from 4.6 mm; ParCAD builds the fillet before the cut and cuts the hole through it, the same 13 faces as the clear part. Closed form of what the reorder removes: the volume is fillet-then-cut's, measured by the harness in the patch-0007 notes as 7570.740.
